{{Quote|Approximately 17,000 years before the Battle of Yavin, as the Republic's fortunes reached a high point during extensive growth into the Expansion Region, the Alsakanese began a comprehensive effort to become the galactic capital.|[[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Milanda Vorgan]]|<ref name="WW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>}}
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''17,018 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] ([[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]])''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that marked the onset of the [[First Alsakan Conflict]] and, as a result, the end of the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]]. The Republic's boundaries had been expanding as [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core-based]] and corporate interests pushed waves of expansion, settlement, and resource harvesting throughout [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. During this time, the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had developed a heated rivalry, and Alsakan's desire for economic, [[Politics/Legends|political]], and cultural superiority and independence had reached a breaking point. The conflict initially started as a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] and armed colonial protection but quickly escalated to war. The conflict officially began with the [[Republic assault on Virujansi]], when the Republic seized control of the planet from Alsakani interests.

==Proem==
{{Quote|The Republic's Great Manifest period (20,000&ndash;17,000 BBY) marked an increased movement into the Rimward territories of the Slice, which became known as the Expansion Region.|From the text of ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
The [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had been a [[Time/Legends|time]] of expansion for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Lead by [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], planetary governments and organizations began massive colonization and resource stockpiling efforts throughout [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In the northern portion of this region, especially near the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], the planet of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] had greatest socio-political control. It had settled colonies and staked claim to numerous resource-rich worlds. [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] competed for worlds in the central portion of the Slice, with its efforts being fronted by Republic-backed mega-corporations.<ref name="EGW" /> Hostilities brewed as the two planets fought for dominance not only economically, but also culturally.<ref name="EA" /><ref name="WW" /><ref name="EGW" /> The Republic's bureaucracy and [[Politics/Legends|politicking]] grew with fervor, fueling the rivalry as [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had become [[Rule of Fifty|so large]] that they were ungovernable. The growing governmental structure included the creation of the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] more than one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the conclusion of the Great Manifest Period. This organization was created to help regulate [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] trade as well as to maintain records of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] transactions and movements.<ref name="EA" /> Such expanding government and loss of local control irked Alsakan and Corellia on philosophical and cultural levels. Alsakan began sending armed warships to protect its colonization interests, which caught the ire of the Coruscant-based corporate barons.<ref name="EGW" />

==The galaxy in 17,018 BBY==
The Republic abruptly cascaded into open fighting with the sudden outbreak of the [[First Alsakan Conflict]] in 17,000 BBY. The intensifying strife between Alsakan and Coruscant had reached a boiling point with the use of Alsakani warships to advance colonization. The [[Grand Companies]]&mdash;the major trading companies along the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] stretch of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]]&mdash;objected to this move, and [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] freighters began clashing with Alsakani warships.<ref name="EGW" /> The Republic backed the Duros merchants, sparking a war between the two factions when they [[Republic assault on Virujansi|assaulted and captured]] [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] in 17,018 BBY. [[17,012 BBY|Six years later]], Alsakan forces [[Alsakani liberation of Virujansi|liberated]] the planet. [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] remained neutral by protecting its interests in the southern portions of the galaxy in spite of its sympathies and philosophical alignments toward Alsakan.<ref name="EGW" />

==Impact==
{{Quote|While the fighting never expanded to a full-scale civil war in the Republic, the first of the Alsakan Conflicts ended the boom of the Great Manifest Period. However, it did not end Alsakan's ambitions, and the Alsakanese would continue to attempt to claim their "rightful" place as galactic capital for another 14,000 years.|[[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Milanda Vorgan]]|<ref name="WW" />}}
Inside the Republic, the conflict between Alsakan and Coruscant was the first of [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|seventeen such skirmishes]] between the two planets. Battles took place for more than three hundred years, including the [[Battle of Kes]] in [[16,921 BBY]], the [[First Siege of Porus Vida]] in [[16,820 BBY]], and the [[Siege of Belasco]], which began in [[16,800 BBY]]. The First Alsakan Conflict was ultimately ended when the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] in [[16,700 BBY]], which threatened to withhold access to the system of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|beacons]]. The Senate also addressed issues regarding representation and bureaucratic control upon the conflict's conclusion. Tension remained high, however, and hostilities resumed 500 years later in [[16,200 BBY]].<ref name="EGW" /> The seventeen conflicts occurred in all, destroying historical landmarks such as [[Belgoth's Beacon]] and the [[Alsakan Mosaics]] while and laying waste to portions of the Expansion Region.<ref name="EA" /> The new period of conflict marked the beginning of the [[Indecta Era]].<ref name="EA" /><ref name="EGW" />

==Notable events==
*The first Alsakan Conflict began after rising tensions<ref name="EA" /> in Alsakan's aim to usurp cultural, economic, and political power from Coruscant resulted in fighting.<ref name="EA" /><ref name="NEC" /><ref name="WW" /><ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The year 17,018 BBY is first mentioned in the ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', with it marking the commencement of the First Alsakan Conflict.<ref name="EGW" /> The exact date of the conflicts had only been established prior as ''approximately'' 17,000 BBY in paper publications ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' along with the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature ''[[The Written Word]]''.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="EA" /><ref name="WW" />
